sources.title: Ox Alpha AI: Free 1M Context Reasoning Model (2026)
sources.snippet: On August 20, 2026, an unannounced frontier reasoning model named Ox Alpha (model identifier: stealth/ox-alpha) appeared on OpenRouter. The model is completely free ($0.00 per 1M input and output tokens) during its initial public preview and features a massive 1,048,576-token context window (1M) alongside native video, image, and text input support.
